"""Original Native crosswalk approach, lead, pedestrian and four-view capture."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import subprocess

from crosswalk_pass_scene import CASES, CAMERAS, request, validate
from native_construction import constructed_scene

AID = "training__C146108__LVMC-11-30-030__motor_vehicle_driver"
FRAMES = 600
RATE = 20


def case_id(slug):
    if slug not in CASES:
        raise ValueError("Unknown exact crosswalk case")
    return AID + "__" + slug


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def put(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")


def xyz(value):
    return [value.x, value.y, value.z]


def body(actor):
    return [xyz(point) for point in actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(actor.get_transform())]


def check():
    return {"cases": [validate(request(slug)) for slug in sorted(CASES)],
            "case_ids": [case_id(slug) for slug in sorted(CASES)],
            "camera_names": sorted(CAMERAS), "planned_frames": FRAMES,
            "rate_hz": RATE, "original_native_observed": False,
            "physical_or_legal_acceptance": False}


def control(carla, actors, scene, index):
    ego, lead, pedestrian = actors["ego"], actors["lead"], actors["pedestrian"]
    lead.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=0, brake=1, hand_brake=True))
    location = pedestrian.get_location()
    if 120 <= index < 220:
        pedestrian.apply_control(carla.WalkerControl(direction=carla.Vector3D(0, 1, 0), speed=1.4))
    else:
        pedestrian.apply_control(carla.WalkerControl(direction=carla.Vector3D(0, 0, 0), speed=0))
    policy = scene["controller"]["policy"]
    ego_x = ego.get_location().x
    if policy == "hold_behind_lead" and ego_x >= -16:
        ego.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=0, brake=1, steer=0))
    else:
        steer = -.3 if policy == "pass_adjacent_lane" and -22 < ego_x < -14 else 0
        ego.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=.42, brake=0, steer=steer))


def capture(slug, output, host="127.0.0.1", port=2000):
    import carla
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from worker_exchange.native_output import seal_capture
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot, restore
    scene = request(slug)
    validate(scene)
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    if output.exists() and any((output / name).exists() for name in
                               ("video_frames.jsonl", "crosswalk_trace.jsonl", "capture-seal.json")):
        raise ValueError("Retain prior Native attempt; choose a fresh output")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    client = carla.Client(host, port)
    client.set_timeout(120)
    prior = snapshot(client)
    encoders = {}
    core = None
    restored = None
    try:
        with constructed_scene(client, carla, scene) as actors:
            world = actors["world"]
            (output / "road.xodr").write_text(actors["map_opendrive"])
            cameras = {}
            for spec in scene["cameras"]:
                incoming = queue.Queue()
                actors["cameras"][spec["name"]].listen(incoming.put)
                cameras[spec["name"]] = incoming
                encoders[spec["name"]] = subprocess.Popen(
                    ["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-f", "rawvideo", "-pixel_format", "bgra",
                     "-video_size", f"{spec['size'][0]}x{spec['size'][1]}", "-framerate", "20",
                     "-i", "-", "-frames:v", "600", "-c:v", "ffv1",
                     str(output / (spec["name"] + ".mkv"))], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
            core = PipelineCapture(client, actors["ego"], output, case_id(slug),
                                   required_observations=[])
            first_elapsed = None
            with (output / "video_frames.jsonl").open("x") as video_stream, \
                    (output / "crosswalk_trace.jsonl").open("x") as trace_stream, \
                    (output / "ego_body.jsonl").open("x") as ego_stream, \
                    (output / "lead_body.jsonl").open("x") as lead_stream, \
                    (output / "pedestrian_body.jsonl").open("x") as pedestrian_stream:
                for index in range(FRAMES):
                    control(carla, actors, scene, index)
                    native = world.tick()
                    snap = world.get_snapshot()
                    if native != snap.frame:
                        raise RuntimeError("Original Native tick/snapshot mismatch")
                    if first_elapsed is None:
                        first_elapsed = snap.timestamp.elapsed_seconds
                    elapsed = snap.timestamp.elapsed_seconds - first_elapsed
                    if abs(elapsed - index / RATE) > .005:
                        raise RuntimeError("Original frame/time join differs")
                    core.capture(native, elapsed, extra={"crosswalk_source": {
                        "lead_actor_id": actors["lead"].id,
                        "pedestrian_actor_id": actors["pedestrian"].id}})
                    source_cameras, hashes = {}, {}
                    for name, incoming in cameras.items():
                        image = incoming.get(timeout=30)
                        if image.frame != native:
                            raise RuntimeError("Original camera/Native frame mismatch: " + name)
                        source_cameras[name] = index
                        hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(image.raw_data).hexdigest()
                        encoders[name].stdin.write(image.raw_data)
                    frame = {"video_frame": index, "native_frame": native, "carla_frame": native,
                             "time_s": index / RATE, "native_elapsed_s": elapsed,
                             "source_cameras": source_cameras, "camera_rgb_sha256": hashes}
                    video_stream.write(json.dumps(frame, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                    ego, lead, pedestrian = actors["ego"], actors["lead"], actors["pedestrian"]
                    trace_stream.write(json.dumps({**frame,
                        "ego_x_m": ego.get_location().x, "ego_y_m": ego.get_location().y,
                        "lead_x_m": lead.get_location().x, "lead_y_m": lead.get_location().y,
                        "ego_length_m": 2 * ego.bounding_box.extent.x,
                        "lead_length_m": 2 * lead.bounding_box.extent.x,
                        "lead_speed_mps": lead.get_velocity().length(),
                        "pedestrian_y_m": pedestrian.get_location().y,
                        "ego_speed_mps": ego.get_velocity().length(),
                        "requested_pass_policy": scene["controller"]["policy"],
                        "crosswalk_kind_requested": scene["crosswalk_kind_requested"],
                        "original_lead_stop_purpose_verified": False}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                    for actor, stream in ((ego, ego_stream), (lead, lead_stream),
                                          (pedestrian, pedestrian_stream)):
                        stream.write(json.dumps({"native_frame": native, "actor_id": actor.id,
                                                 "body_vertices_m": body(actor)}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
            for process in encoders.values():
                process.stdin.close()
                if process.wait(timeout=120) != 0:
                    raise RuntimeError("Original source camera encoder failed")
            for name in CAMERAS:
                count = subprocess.check_output(
                    ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-count_frames", "-select_streams", "v:0",
                     "-show_entries", "stream=nb_read_frames", "-of", "default=nokey=1:noprint_wrappers=1",
                     str(output / (name + ".mkv"))], text=True, timeout=120).strip()
                if count != "600":
                    raise ValueError("Original camera full decode differs: " + name)
            core.close(confirmed=True)
            core = None
            source_names = ("road.xodr", "crosswalk_trace.jsonl", "ego_body.jsonl",
                            "lead_body.jsonl", "pedestrian_body.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl")
            put(output / "crosswalk_context.json", {"case_id": case_id(slug),
                "source_kind": "original_native_crosswalk_pass_readback",
                "source_sha256": {name: sha(output / name) for name in source_names},
                "original_intersection_review_required": True,
                "original_lead_stop_purpose_review_required": True,
                "physical_or_legal_acceptance": False})
        restored = restore(client, prior)
        put(output / "acquisition-provenance.json", {"provenance_kind": "native",
            "diagnostic_fixture": False, "native_executed": True,
            "physical_acceptance_claimed": False})
        seal_capture(output, frames=FRAMES, restoration=restored, errors=[],
                     encoder_exit_codes={name: process.returncode for name, process in encoders.items()},
                     context={"case_id": case_id(slug), "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
                              "original_stop_purpose_review_required": True})
        return {"case_id": case_id(slug), "source_frames": FRAMES,
                "original_capture_saved": True, "physical_or_legal_acceptance": False}
    except BaseException:
        if core is not None:
            core.close(confirmed=False)
        for process in encoders.values():
            if process.poll() is None:
                if process.stdin and not process.stdin.closed:
                    process.stdin.close()
                process.kill()
                process.wait()
        if restored is None:
            restore(client, prior)
        raise


def selected_slug(config, supplied=None):
    selected = config.get("selected_case_id", "")
    slug = supplied or selected.rsplit("__", 1)[-1]
    if slug not in CASES or selected != case_id(slug):
        raise ValueError("Materialized config case differs")
    return slug


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--case")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps(check(), sort_keys=True))
    else:
        config = json.loads(Path("config.json").read_text())
        try:
            slug = selected_slug(config, args.case)
        except ValueError as error:
            parser.error(str(error))
        if not args.output_dir:
            parser.error("Selected case and output directory required")
        print(json.dumps(capture(slug, args.output_dir, args.host, args.port), sort_keys=True))

"""Lazy CARLA construction for the exact crosswalk pass or hold requests."""
from contextlib import contextmanager
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from crosswalk_pass_scene import CAMERAS, validate


def pose(carla, xyz, pitch=0, yaw=0):
    return carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=xyz[0], y=xyz[1], z=xyz[2]),
                           carla.Rotation(pitch=pitch, yaw=yaw))


def checked_map(world, scene):
    source = world.get_map().to_opendrive()
    root = ET.fromstring(source)
    road = root.find("road")
    if road is None or road.get("id") != "146108":
        raise ValueError("Original one-way road readback differs")
    if len(road.findall("lanes/laneSection/right/lane")) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Original two same-direction lanes missing")
    kind = scene["crosswalk_kind_requested"]
    if kind == "marked":
        if road.find("objects/object") is None or road.find("objects/object").get("type") != "crosswalk":
            raise ValueError("Original marked crossing missing")
    elif kind == "unmarked_intersection":
        if (root.find("junction/connection/laneLink") is None or len(root.findall("road")) != 4 or
                road.find("objects/object").get("type") == "crosswalk"):
            raise ValueError("Original unmarked intersection geometry missing or painted")
    else:
        raise ValueError("Crossing kind differs")
    return source


@contextmanager
def constructed_scene(client, carla, scene):
    validate(scene)
    world = client.generate_opendrive_world(scene["road_opendrive"])
    source = checked_map(world, scene)
    settings = world.get_settings()
    prior_sync, prior_delta = settings.synchronous_mode, settings.fixed_delta_seconds
    owned = []
    try:
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = .05
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        observed = world.get_settings()
        if not observed.synchronous_mode or abs(observed.fixed_delta_seconds - .05) > 1e-6:
            raise RuntimeError("Original 20 Hz readback differs")
        library = world.get_blueprint_library()
        def spawn(blueprint, xyz, yaw=0):
            actor = world.try_spawn_actor(library.find(blueprint), pose(carla, xyz, yaw=yaw))
            if actor is None:
                raise RuntimeError("Original actor spawn failed: " + blueprint)
            owned.append(actor)
            return actor
        ego = spawn(scene["ego"]["blueprint"], [*scene["ego"]["start_xy_m"], .5])
        lead = spawn(scene["lead"]["blueprint"], [*scene["lead"]["center_xy_m"], .5])
        walkers = library.filter("walker.pedestrian.*")
        if not walkers:
            raise RuntimeError("Original pedestrian blueprint unavailable")
        pedestrian = world.try_spawn_actor(walkers[0], pose(carla, [*scene["pedestrian"]["start_xy_m"], .5]))
        if pedestrian is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Original pedestrian spawn failed")
        owned.append(pedestrian)
        cameras = {}
        for spec in scene["cameras"]:
            bp = library.find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            bp.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(spec["size"][0]))
            bp.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(spec["size"][1]))
            bp.set_attribute("fov", "80")
            sensor = world.spawn_actor(bp, pose(carla, spec["xyz"], spec["pitch"]),
                                       attach_to=ego if spec.get("attach_to_ego") else None)
            if sensor is None:
                raise RuntimeError("Original camera spawn failed: " + spec["name"])
            owned.append(sensor)
            cameras[spec["name"]] = sensor
        if set(cameras) != CAMERAS:
            raise ValueError("Four original cameras missing")
        yield {"world": world, "ego": ego, "lead": lead, "pedestrian": pedestrian,
               "cameras": cameras, "map_opendrive": source,
               "crossing_authority_observed": False,
               "lead_stop_purpose_observed": False}
    finally:
        for actor in reversed(owned):
            actor.destroy()
        settings.synchronous_mode, settings.fixed_delta_seconds = prior_sync, prior_delta
        world.apply_settings(settings)

"""Authored one-way two-lane marked and intersection-unmarked requests."""

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import math

CASES = {"false", "true", "unmarked_false", "unmarked_true"}
CAMERAS = {"overview", "driver_reference", "reference_corner", "approach"}


def road_xml(unmarked=False):
    root = ET.Element("OpenDRIVE")
    ET.SubElement(root, "header", revMajor="1", revMinor="4", name="C146108-crosswalk-pass",
                  version="1", north="10", south="-10", east="80", west="-80", vendor="full-train-worker")
    road = ET.SubElement(root, "road", id="146108", name="one_way_two_lane", length="160", junction="-1")
    ET.SubElement(road, "link")
    geom = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(road, "planView"), "geometry", s="0", x="-80", y="0", hdg="0", length="160")
    ET.SubElement(geom, "line")
    ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(road, "elevationProfile"), "elevation", s="0", a="0", b="0", c="0", d="0")
    lanes = ET.SubElement(road, "lanes")
    ET.SubElement(lanes, "laneOffset", s="0", a="0", b="0", c="0", d="0")
    section = ET.SubElement(lanes, "laneSection", s="0")
    ET.SubElement(section, "left")
    center = ET.SubElement(section, "center")
    ET.SubElement(center, "lane", id="0", type="none", level="false")
    right = ET.SubElement(section, "right")
    for ident in (-1, -2):
        lane = ET.SubElement(right, "lane", id=str(ident), type="driving", level="false")
        ET.SubElement(lane, "width", sOffset="0", a="3.5", b="0", c="0", d="0")
    objects = ET.SubElement(road, "objects")
    if unmarked:
        ET.SubElement(objects, "object", id="intersection-mouth-146108", s="78", t="-3.5",
                      name="intersection_unmarked_crossing_reference", type="none",
                      orientation="none", zOffset="0", length="4", width="7",
                      hdg="0", pitch="0", roll="0")
        for ident, y, length, junction_id in ((146109, -20, 13, -1),
                                              (146110, -7, 14, 146108),
                                              (146111, 7, 13, -1)):
            crossing_road = ET.SubElement(root, "road", id=str(ident),
                                          name="intersection_cross_road", length=str(length),
                                          junction=str(junction_id))
            link = ET.SubElement(crossing_road, "link")
            if ident == 146109:
                ET.SubElement(link, "successor", elementType="junction", elementId="146108")
            elif ident == 146111:
                ET.SubElement(link, "predecessor", elementType="junction", elementId="146108")
            else:
                ET.SubElement(link, "predecessor", elementType="road", elementId="146109", contactPoint="end")
                ET.SubElement(link, "successor", elementType="road", elementId="146111", contactPoint="start")
            geometry = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(crossing_road, "planView"),
                                     "geometry", s="0", x="0", y=str(y),
                                     hdg=str(math.pi / 2), length=str(length))
            ET.SubElement(geometry, "line")
            ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(crossing_road, "elevationProfile"),
                          "elevation", s="0", a="0", b="0", c="0", d="0")
            crossing_lanes = ET.SubElement(crossing_road, "lanes")
            ET.SubElement(crossing_lanes, "laneOffset", s="0", a="0", b="0", c="0", d="0")
            section_cross = ET.SubElement(crossing_lanes, "laneSection", s="0")
            ET.SubElement(section_cross, "left")
            ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(section_cross, "center"), "lane", id="0", type="none", level="false")
            right_cross = ET.SubElement(section_cross, "right")
            cross_lane = ET.SubElement(right_cross, "lane", id="-1", type="driving", level="false")
            ET.SubElement(cross_lane, "width", sOffset="0", a="3.5", b="0", c="0", d="0")
            ET.SubElement(crossing_road, "objects")
            ET.SubElement(crossing_road, "signals")
        junction = ET.SubElement(root, "junction", id="146108", name="crossing-intersection")
        connection = ET.SubElement(junction, "connection", id="0", incomingRoad="146109",
                                   connectingRoad="146110", contactPoint="start")
        ET.SubElement(connection, "laneLink", **{"from": "-1", "to": "-1"})
    else:
        ET.SubElement(objects, "object", id="marked-crosswalk-146108", s="78", t="-3.5",
                      name="marked_crosswalk", type="crosswalk", orientation="none",
                      zOffset="0", length="4", width="7", hdg="0", pitch="0", roll="0")
    ET.SubElement(road, "signals")
    return ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")


def request(case):
    if case not in CASES:
        raise ValueError("Unknown pass policy")
    unmarked = case.startswith("unmarked_")
    return {"format": "worker-authored-crosswalk-pass-request", "case": case,
            "crosswalk_kind_requested": "unmarked_intersection" if unmarked else "marked",
            "road_opendrive": road_xml(unmarked), "crosswalk_x_m": [-2, 2],
            "lead": {"blueprint": "vehicle.tesla.model3", "center_xy_m": [-6, -1.75],
                     "body_length_m": 4.5, "requested_stopped_for_pedestrian": True},
            "pedestrian": {"blueprint": "walker.pedestrian.0001", "start_xy_m": [0, -8],
                           "crossing_x_m": 0, "requested_crossing_interval_frames": [120, 220]},
            "ego": {"blueprint": "vehicle.tesla.model3", "start_xy_m": [-40, -1.75],
                    "heading_deg": 0, "body_length_m": 4.5},
            "controller": {"policy": "pass_adjacent_lane" if case.endswith("true") else "hold_behind_lead",
                           "adjacent_lane_y_m": -5.25, "hold_center_x_m": -13},
            "cameras": [{"name": "overview", "xyz": [-5, -10, 20], "pitch": -45, "size": [1920, 1080]},
                        {"name": "driver_reference", "xyz": [1, 0, 2], "pitch": -8,
                         "attach_to_ego": True, "size": [1280, 720]},
                        {"name": "reference_corner", "xyz": [3, -12, 8], "pitch": -25, "size": [1280, 720]},
                        {"name": "approach", "xyz": [-12, -8, 6], "pitch": -15, "size": [1280, 720]}],
            "rate_hz": 20, "duration_s": 30, "planned_frames": 600,
            "native_road_verified": False, "physical_success_claimed": False}


def validate(value):
    root = ET.fromstring(value["road_opendrive"])
    road = root.find("road")
    if root.tag != "OpenDRIVE" or road is None or road.attrib["id"] != "146108":
        raise ValueError("One-way road request missing")
    if len(road.findall("lanes/laneSection/right/lane")) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Two same-direction lanes missing")
    if value["crosswalk_kind_requested"] == "marked":
        if road.find("objects/object").attrib.get("type") != "crosswalk":
            raise ValueError("Marked crosswalk missing")
    elif value["crosswalk_kind_requested"] == "unmarked_intersection":
        if (root.find("junction/connection/laneLink") is None or
                len(root.findall("road")) != 4 or
                road.find("objects/object").attrib.get("type") == "crosswalk"):
            raise ValueError("Unmarked intersection reference missing or painted")
    else:
        raise ValueError("Crosswalk kind missing")
    if set(c["name"] for c in value["cameras"]) != CAMERAS:
        raise ValueError("Four camera requests missing")
    if value["planned_frames"] != 600 or value["rate_hz"] != 20 or value["native_road_verified"]:
        raise ValueError("Duration or source assertion invalid")
    return {"case": value["case"], "camera_count": 4, "planned_frames": 600,
            "authored_request_checked": True, "native_road_verified": False}

"""Synthetic source-shaped marked/unmarked overtake comparison proof."""

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from crosswalk_pass_scene import CASES, request, validate
from measure_crosswalk_pass import CAMERAS, FRAMES, HASHES, measure


def context(kind="marked"):
    result = {"source_kind": "original_native_crosswalk_pass_readback",
              "crosswalk_kind": kind, "intersection_crossing_sourced": kind == "unmarked_intersection",
              "same_direction_rear_approach": True,
              "lead_stopped_for_pedestrian_sourced": True,
              "crosswalk_near_x_m": -2, "crosswalk_far_x_m": 2,
              "lead_center_x_m": -6}
    for name in HASHES:
        result[name + "_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(("synthetic-fixture:" + name).encode()).hexdigest()
    return result


def trace(case):
    rows = []
    for i in range(FRAMES):
        if case.endswith("true"):
            ego_x = -40 + 0.25 * i
            ego_y = -1.75 if i < 60 else (-1.75 - (i - 60) * 3.5 / 20 if i < 80 else -5.25)
        elif case.endswith("false"):
            ego_x, ego_y = -40 + min(i, 120) * 27 / 120, -1.75
        else:
            raise ValueError("Unknown fixture")
        ped_y = max(-8, min(8, -4 + (i - 120) * 0.08))
        rows.append({"video_frame": i, "native_frame": 950000 + i, "time_s": i / 20,
                     "source_cameras": {name: i for name in CAMERAS},
                     "ego_x_m": ego_x, "ego_y_m": ego_y, "ego_length_m": 4.5,
                     "lead_y_m": -1.75, "lead_length_m": 4.5, "lead_speed_mps": 0,
                     "pedestrian_y_m": ped_y})
    return rows


def reject(label, source, rows, expected):
    try:
        measure(source, rows)
    except ValueError as error:
        assert expected in str(error), (label, str(error))
        return {"test": label, "rejected": str(error)}
    raise AssertionError(label + " unexpectedly passed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    scenes = {case: validate(request(case)) for case in CASES}
    hold = measure(context(), trace("false"))
    passing = measure(context(), trace("true"))
    unmarked_hold = measure(context("unmarked_intersection"), trace("unmarked_false"))
    unmarked_passing = measure(context("unmarked_intersection"), trace("unmarked_true"))
    assert hold["pass_observed"] is False and passing["pass_observed"] is True
    assert unmarked_hold["pass_observed"] is False and unmarked_passing["pass_observed"] is True
    assert not hold["adjacent_longitudinal_overlap_frames"]
    assert passing["adjacent_longitudinal_overlap_frames"]
    assert passing["passed_lead_during_pedestrian_crossing_frames"]
    assert hold["legal_compliance"] == passing["legal_compliance"] == "unassessed"
    negative = []
    source = context()
    source.pop("crosswalk_reference_sha256")
    negative.append(reject("missing_crosswalk_source", source, trace("true"), "source hash"))
    source = context("unmarked_intersection")
    source["intersection_crossing_sourced"] = False
    negative.append(reject("unsourced_unmarked_intersection", source, trace("unmarked_true"), "Unmarked intersection"))
    source = context()
    source["lead_stopped_for_pedestrian_sourced"] = False
    negative.append(reject("unsourced_stop_purpose", source, trace("true"), "Purpose"))
    negative.append(reject("short_capture", context(), trace("true")[:-1], "Incomplete"))
    rows = trace("true")
    rows[200]["source_cameras"].pop("approach")
    negative.append(reject("missing_camera", context(), rows, "camera"))
    rows = trace("true")

    rows = trace("true")

    rows = trace("true")
    for row in rows:

                      "proof_sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}))

"""Saved-only crosswalk pass measurement; original review remains required."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from measure_crosswalk_pass import CAMERAS, FRAMES, HASHES, measure


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def review(path, source_kind, case_id):
    require(path.is_file(), "Missing required source: " + path.name)
    value = json.loads(path.read_text())
    require(value.get("source_kind") == source_kind and value.get("case_id") == case_id and
            value.get("reviewer") and value.get("full_interval_reviewed") is True,
            "Independent original source review missing: " + path.name)
    return value


def measure_saved(attempt, case_id):
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    sources = ("road.xodr", "crosswalk_trace.jsonl", "ego_body.jsonl", "lead_body.jsonl",
               "pedestrian_body.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl")
    for name in sources:
        require((attempt / name).is_file(), "Missing required source: " + name)
    crossing = review(attempt / "crosswalk-review.json", "independent_original_crosswalk_review", case_id)
    purpose = review(attempt / "purpose-review.json", "independent_original_stop_purpose_review", case_id)
    require(crossing["reviewer"] != purpose["reviewer"], "Crossing and stop purpose reviewers must differ")
    require(crossing.get("native_map_sha256") == sha(attempt / "road.xodr") and
            crossing.get("crosswalk_kind") in ("marked", "unmarked_intersection") and
            crossing.get("intersection_source_id") and crossing.get("crosswalk_reference_source_id"),
            "Original crossing or intersection source missing")
    if crossing["crosswalk_kind"] == "unmarked_intersection":
        require(crossing.get("intersection_crossing_sourced") is True,
                "Unmarked intersection crossing unsourced")
    video_hashes = {name: sha(attempt / (name + ".mkv")) for name in CAMERAS}
    body_hashes = {name: sha(attempt / name) for name in
                   ("ego_body.jsonl", "lead_body.jsonl", "pedestrian_body.jsonl")}
    require(purpose.get("video_sha256") == video_hashes and
            purpose.get("body_sha256") == body_hashes and
            purpose.get("lead_stopped_for_pedestrian_sourced") is True and
            purpose.get("lead_stop_purpose_source_id") and purpose.get("pedestrian_crossing_source_id"),
            "Original stopped-lead purpose or pedestrian source missing")
    trace = rows(attempt / "crosswalk_trace.jsonl")
    frames = rows(attempt / "video_frames.jsonl")
    require(len(trace) == len(frames) == FRAMES, "600 joined original frames required")
    for i, (row, frame) in enumerate(zip(trace, frames)):
        require(row.get("video_frame") == frame.get("video_frame") == i and
                row.get("native_frame") == frame.get("native_frame") and
                row.get("source_cameras") == frame.get("source_cameras"),
                "Original Native/video frame join changed")
    source_hash = {name: sha(attempt / name) for name in sources}
    source_hash["crosswalk-review.json"] = sha(attempt / "crosswalk-review.json")
    source_hash["purpose-review.json"] = sha(attempt / "purpose-review.json")
    source_hash.update({name + ".mkv": value for name, value in video_hashes.items()})
    context = {"source_kind": "original_native_crosswalk_pass_readback",
               "crosswalk_kind": crossing["crosswalk_kind"],
               "intersection_crossing_sourced": crossing["crosswalk_kind"] == "unmarked_intersection",
               "same_direction_rear_approach": crossing.get("same_direction_rear_approach") is True,
               "lead_stopped_for_pedestrian_sourced": True,
               "crosswalk_near_x_m": crossing.get("crosswalk_near_x_m"),
               "crosswalk_far_x_m": crossing.get("crosswalk_far_x_m"),
               "lead_center_x_m": purpose.get("lead_center_x_m")}
    for name in HASHES:
        context[name + "_sha256"] = source_hash[{
            "native_map": "road.xodr", "crosswalk_reference": "crosswalk-review.json",
            "lane_directions": "road.xodr", "ego_body": "ego_body.jsonl",
            "lead_body": "lead_body.jsonl", "ego_motion": "crosswalk_trace.jsonl",
            "lead_motion": "crosswalk_trace.jsonl", "pedestrian_body_motion": "pedestrian_body.jsonl",
            "camera_manifest": "video_frames.jsonl"}[name]]
    measured = measure(context, trace)
    measured.update(case_id=case_id, source_sha256=source_hash,
                    original_crossing_reviewed=True, original_stop_purpose_reviewed=True,
                    legal_compliance="unassessed")
    return measured, trace


def measure_crosswalk(attempt, case_id):
    return measure_saved(attempt, case_id)[0]


def finalize(attempt, output):
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    config = json.loads((attempt / "config.json").read_text())
    case_id = config["selected_case_id"]
    measured, observed = measure_saved(attempt, case_id)
    construction = json.loads((attempt / "construction.json").read_text())
    evidence = []
    (attempt / "channels").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for channel in construction["recording_description"]["channels"]:
        name = channel["name"]
        relative = "channels/" + name + ".jsonl"
        with (attempt / relative).open("x") as stream:
            for row in observed:
                stream.write(json.dumps({"time_s": row["time_s"], "value": row}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        evidence.append({"name": name, "unit": channel["unit"], "reference": relative})
    instance = {item["name"]: {"source_sha256": measured["source_sha256"],
                               "original_source_review_required": True}
                for item in construction["recording_description"]["context_inputs"]}
    (attempt / "instance-context.json").write_text(json.dumps(instance, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    for item in construction["recording_description"]["context_inputs"]:
        evidence.append({"name": item["name"], "unit": item["unit"],
                         "reference": "instance-context.json"})
    requirements = {"crosswalk_pass_observation_" + str(i): {
        "method": "measure_crosswalk", "value": measured,
        "sources": measured["source_sha256"]} for i in range(3)}
    report = {"format": "worker-analysis-report", "case_id": case_id,
              "measurements": requirements, "source_complete": True,
              "physical_or_legal_acceptance": False}
    result = {"case_id": case_id, "measured_values": measured,
              "target_checks": [{"target": "source-reviewed pass at crossing",
                "requested": "source-reviewed original", "measured": measured["pass_observed"],
                "method": "measure_crosswalk", "tolerance": 0,
                "matched": measured["pass_observed"],
                "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
                "cause_evidence": list(measured["source_sha256"])}],
              "setup_confirmed": False, "behavior_attempted": False,
              "maneuver_completed": False,
              "termination_reason": "Saved original-source reduction; physical review pending",
              "physical_failure_flags": ["Original physical completion unconfirmed"],
              "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
              "video_references": [name + ".mkv" for name in
                                   ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")],
              "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
              "recording_description": construction["recording_description"],
              "recording_evidence": evidence, "realized_observables": {}, "accepted": False}
    from worker_exchange.native_output import write_result
    write_result(attempt, result)
    Path(output).write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    return report


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(finalize(args.attempt, args.output), sort_keys=True))
